## Objective
- Finish the existing skateboarding game so it is complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Build request; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.

## Decisions
- Treat the request as a final polish pass on the existing Three.js skateboarding prototype.
- Add a proper run reset/replay flow and a one-time challenge completion state.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game prototype, UI, and runtime scripts.
- Added `resetRun()` to reset gameplay state and HUD, and wired reset to `R`.
- Added `completeRun()` to stop the session and show the replay overlay when the 5,000-point challenge is reached.
- Updated the start handler to reset and start a fresh run.

### Active
- Validate gameplay, challenge completion, and replay flow in a browser.
- Inspect and fix any gameplay issues found during validation.

### Blocked
- Browser automation via `playwright-cli` opened the game, but the standalone Node test failed because `playwright` was not installed (`Cannot find module 'playwright'`).
- No screenshot was captured yet; the attempted default session screenshot also failed because it targeted a different browser session.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current `game.js` for consistency and syntax, especially challenge completion and reset flow.
2. Run a browser check using the named `playwright-cli` session or locate the installed Playwright module.
3. Exercise riding, ollie/tricks, score accumulation, challenge completion, and replay; fix any issues.
4. Summarize the finished game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Three.js scene and skating gameplay; modified for reset/replay and challenge completion.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: HUD, controls, start overlay, and script loading.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/console-2026-11-02T10-19-46-179Z.log`: Browser console output; only a missing favicon and rendering warnings were observed.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/page-2026-11-02T10-19-47-927Z.yml`: Browser snapshot confirming the game UI and start overlay rendered.

## Important Context
- Local HTTP server responded successfully at `http://localhost:3000/`.
- `playwright-cli` browser session named `playground` opened the page; snapshot title was `SKATE//CITY 04`.
- Changes are uncommitted.
